prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption:
A modern corporate boardroom scene, captured in a cinematic, wide-angle shot. The central subject is a young Asian man in business attire—light blue dress shirt, sleeves rolled up, and a tie—standing confidently in front of a large digital screen. He gestures animatedly with his hands, mid-presentation, conveying energy and engagement. The screen behind him displays a detailed financial business plan with graphs and text in blue and white, adding a professional, data-driven atmosphere.

Seated in the foreground and to the left are two older men, partially out of focus, dressed in suits, attentively listening to the presenter. On the right, a young boy in a white shirt sits at the table, also engaged, adding an unexpected, humanizing element to the corporate setting. A sleek, silver laptop sits open on the table, reflecting the ambient light.

The color palette is cool and subdued, dominated by blues, greys, and soft natural light filtering through large windows, creating a calm, focused mood. The lighting is soft and diffused, with gentle highlights on faces and subtle shadows, enhancing the realism and depth. The composition uses shallow depth of field to keep the presenter and screen in sharp focus while the audience remains slightly blurred, drawing attention to the action and information being shared. The overall style is polished and contemporary, evoking the look of a high-end business drama or a professional commercial, with a sense of motion and immediacy in the presenter’s expressive stance.
